list.name: market
list.label: Market
list.query: Spot (1) : 1, Futures (2) : 2, Options on spot (3) : 3, Options on futures (4) : 4, Forward (5) : 5

list.name: asset
list.label: Asset
list.query:
SELECT asset
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY max(CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END) DESC NULLS LAST, asset
list.definition:
SELECT asset
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY max(CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END) DESC NULLS LAST, asset

panels.title: Assets
panels.description: Number of selected assets present in the reports in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset) AS assets
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Monthly reports
panels.description: Number of monthly fee variable reports with the selected assets in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT report_dt) AS reports
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Average settlement fee change in range
panels.description: Mean change of the selected assets' settlement fee from the first to the last report in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    arg_max(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE
      / nullif(arg_min(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT avg(change) AS avg_change
FROM r

panels.title: Latest validity month
panels.description: Validity month of the most recent report with the selected assets in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(valid_from), '%Y-%m') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Settlement fee per contract (BRL)
panels.description: Settlement fee per contract per selected asset by validity month, USD fees converted at the report's rate (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset,
  max(CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END) AS settlement_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND settlement_fee > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Settlement fee change since start of range
panels.description: Settlement fee relative to each asset's first fee in the range, to compare assets on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, max(settlement_fee)::DOUBLE AS fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, fee / nullif(first_value(fee) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Monthly settlement fee change
panels.description: Settlement fee vs the previous report's fee, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, max(settlement_fee)::DOUBLE AS fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
    AND valid_from::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 45 DAY
    AND valid_from::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, asset, fee / nullif(lag(fee) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT time, asset, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Settlement fee in reference currency
panels.description: BRL settlement fee divided by its FX conversion rate (USD, EUR, MXN), i.e. the fee in foreign currency; flat lines mean the BRL fee only moved with FX (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset,
  max(settlement_fee::DOUBLE / conversion_rate::DOUBLE) AS fee_in_reference_unit
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL'
  AND settlement_fee > 0
  AND conversion_rate > 0
  AND conversion_rate < 100
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Conversion rates applied
panels.description: Conversion rate per conversion instrument used by the selected assets, labelled with sample assets (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND conversion_instrument_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
),
labels AS (
  SELECT conversion_instrument_id,
    conversion_instrument_id::VARCHAR || ' (' || array_to_string(list_sort(list(DISTINCT asset))[1:4], ', ')
      || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT asset) > 4 THEN ', …' ELSE '' END || ')' AS conversion
  FROM d
  GROUP BY conversion_instrument_id
)
SELECT d.valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time, labels.conversion, max(d.conversion_rate)::DOUBLE AS conversion_rate
FROM d
JOIN labels USING (conversion_instrument_id)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, conversion

panels.title: Holding fee daily value
panels.description: Daily holding (permanence) fee value per contract per selected asset, in its own currency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, max(holding_daily_value)::DOUBLE AS holding_daily_value
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND holding_daily_value IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Holding fee reduction factor
panels.description: Holding (permanence) fee reduction factor per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, max(holding_reduction_factor)::DOUBLE AS holding_reduction_factor
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND holding_reduction_factor IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Settlement cost of one contract each (BRL), stacked by asset
panels.description: BRL settlement fee for one contract of each selected asset, stacked so the top edge is the cost of the basket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset,
  max(CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END) AS settlement_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Assets in the report, stacked by segment
panels.description: Distinct assets per segment in each monthly report for the selected markets, stacked so the top edge is the total; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  count(DISTINCT asset) FILTER (WHERE segment = '4') AS "Commodities",
  count(DISTINCT asset) FILTER (WHERE segment = '5') AS "Financial",
  count(DISTINCT asset) FILTER (WHERE segment = '6') AS "Gold",
  count(DISTINCT asset) FILTER (WHERE segment NOT IN ('4', '5', '6')) AS "Other"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Selected assets (latest report in range)
panels.description: All fee variables of the selected assets in the latest monthly report in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  CASE segment WHEN '4' THEN 'Commodities' WHEN '5' THEN 'Financial' WHEN '6' THEN 'Gold' ELSE segment END AS segment,
  CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' WHEN '5' THEN 'Forward' ELSE market END AS market,
  settlement_fee::DOUBLE AS settlement_fee,
  settlement_fee_ccy,
  CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END AS settlement_fee_brl,
  holding_daily_value::DOUBLE AS holding_daily_value,
  holding_daily_value_ccy,
  holding_reduction_factor::DOUBLE AS holding_reduction_factor,
  physical_delivery_rate::DOUBLE AS physical_delivery_rate,
  conversion_instrument_id,
  conversion_ref_dt,
  conversion_rate::DOUBLE AS conversion_rate,
  valid_from,
  valid_to
FROM d
WHERE report_dt = (SELECT max(report_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY settlement_fee_brl DESC NULLS LAST, asset, market

panels.title: Fee variable changes vs previous report
panels.description: Fee variables of the selected assets that changed vs the previous monthly report.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (
  UNPIVOT (
    SELECT valid_from, market, asset,
      settlement_fee, holding_reduction_factor, holding_daily_value, physical_delivery_rate
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE asset IN ($asset)
      AND market IN ($market)
  )
  ON settlement_fee, holding_reduction_factor, holding_daily_value, physical_delivery_rate
  INTO NAME fee_variable VALUE amount
),
d AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY market, asset, fee_variable ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_amount
  FROM u
)
SELECT
  valid_from,
  asset,
  market,
  fee_variable,
  prev_amount::DOUBLE AS previous_value,
  amount::DOUBLE AS current_value,
  amount::DOUBLE / nullif(prev_amount::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS change
FROM d
WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
  AND amount <> prev_amount
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY valid_from DESC, fee_variable, abs(amount - prev_amount) DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Highest settlement fees (latest report)
panels.description: Top 15 BRL-equivalent settlement fees in the latest report for the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  CASE segment WHEN '4' THEN 'Commodities' WHEN '5' THEN 'Financial' WHEN '6' THEN 'Gold' ELSE segment END AS segment,
  settlement_fee::DOUBLE AS settlement_fee,
  settlement_fee_ccy AS ccy,
  CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END AS settlement_fee_brl
FROM d
WHERE report_dt = (SELECT max(report_dt) FROM d)
  AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY settlement_fee_brl DESC, asset
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest settlement fee increases (range)
panels.description: Top 15 settlement fee changes from first to last report in the range for the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    any_value(settlement_fee_ccy) AS ccy,
    arg_min(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS first_fee,
    arg_max(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS last_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT *, last_fee / first_fee - 1 AS change
FROM r
WHERE first_fee > 0
ORDER BY change DESC, asset
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest settlement fee decreases (range)
panels.description: Bottom 15 settlement fee changes from first to last report in the range for the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    any_value(settlement_fee_ccy) AS ccy,
    arg_min(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS first_fee,
    arg_max(settlement_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS last_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND settlement_fee IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT *, last_fee / first_fee - 1 AS change
FROM r
WHERE first_fee > 0
ORDER BY change ASC, asset
LIMIT 15

panels.title: $asset fees and conversion rate
panels.description: Settlement fee (BRL) and holding daily value on the left axis, conversion rate on the right axis, one panel per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN settlement_fee_ccy = 'BRL' THEN settlement_fee::DOUBLE ELSE settlement_fee::DOUBLE * conversion_rate::DOUBLE END) AS "Settlement fee (BRL)",
  max(holding_daily_value)::DOUBLE AS "Holding daily value",
  max(conversion_rate)::DOUBLE AS "Conversion rate"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_variables/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset = $asset
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
